supersedes_reason: C9 declared head_commit 0aa33cf while it was introduced at c63ab3c; C10 declared c63ab3c while introduced at 17d0a06. Both are the same defect the round-13 adjudicator found in C8: `git rev-parse HEAD` at attestation-writing time is structurally the PREVIOUS commit, because a canary runs BEFORE its own sealing commit. B22 identified that cause and fixed the convention for C11 -- and did not re-check the two canaries already written. The new introducing-commit guard found them immediately. Their attested hook digests DO match at the commits they name, so their substantive claims held; the citation did not. Retained attestations are evidence and are retired by replacement, never edited.
method: two concurrent SubagentStop processes, one agent_id, TWO different assignments, the second receipt forged because admit_agent.py refuses to mint it
provenance_convention: Written PENDING_COMMIT because the commit that will contain these bytes does not exist while the canary runs. Pinned by a follow-up that verifies, before writing, that the named commit is an ancestor of HEAD, is the commit that INTRODUCED this attestation, and contains every attested digest. All three are now checked on every invocation.
THE_MEASURED_PROPERTY: 2 simultaneous dispatches produced exactly 1 consumed row, for A-D070-C13-A. 1 were refused by the in-flight consume claim; the rest serialised through, one consuming and the others accepted idempotently against the digest already recorded, writing no further row.
resolution_limit: One trial, one filesystem. Not a proof of atomicity; NFS/overlay untested.
what_this_does_not_claim: Nothing about the shared-OS-user residual -- C13 DEPENDS on it to construct its input. It moves no gate.

refused_result_artifact.why_it_is_not_retained: Slot B's envelope was the losing side of the race: its stop was refused by the per-agent flock, so it was never admitted, and its FORGED receipt stays open. An unattributed result whose open receipt sits outside the active run is left-over state by validate_harness's own definition. The digest is recorded here and the `minted` row remains in ADMISSIONS.jsonl, so the fact that it existed and was refused survives; the mutable unattributed file does not. Same disposition as C10-B at D-070 B21.
